senses.gloss: (b. h.; denom. of שֶׁרֶץ)to bring forth moving creatures.
units: <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 117:1">Midr. Till. to Ps. CXVII</cite> <he>המים … והן שׁוֹרְצִין</he> the waters are the work of his hand, and they beget life.

<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 10:1">Ex. R. s. 10</cite> <he>צפרדע … הִשְׁרִיצָה וכ׳</he> there was one frog, and it bred and filled the land &c.; <cite ref="Sanhedrin 67b">Snh. 67ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 183">Yalk. Ex. 183</cite>.
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 13:5">Lev. R. s. 13</cite> <he>מה … מַשְׁרֶצֶת וכ׳</he> as the scorpion casts sixty at a time &c.; a. e.
